quests.title: Good Hunter Express

dialogue.sit: I'd love to, but I have to get going.

dialogue.t: Eh? But... Oh, alright, I'll get someone else to do it...
Thank you so much. It's much too far away, and we haven't the people to spare.
Ah, yes, please be careful while you travel. Don't run too fast or use your wind glider. You definitely shouldn't climb either...
If you takes too many bumps along the way, the meat sauce and spaghetti might come apart... and if that happens, I don't think the customer will accept it.

dialogue.section: Deliver the food to Slacking Angelo

dialogue.t: Sheesh, I wonder where my order's gone. And I'd gone through so much trouble to find a comfortable spot like this, too...

dialogue.sit: I heard that someone placed a custom order...

dialogue.t: Right, I believe a certain... Angelo ordered — and paid for — a serving of our Flaming Red Bolognese.
After that, he asked that we deliver it to him near Brightcrown Canyon. But that's some distance away, and I don't have anyone I can send there...
If you're alright with it, could you help us deliver it to him?
Ah, you're finally here. If you'd taken any longer, I might have fallen asleep.
Thank you, I'll just take this.

quests.description: The Good Hunter has a special order that needs sending out...
